evaluation: nested leave-one-subject-out; inner subject CV selects model; fixed default decision boundary; outer subject excluded from preprocessing and selection
limitations: Same dataset was explored by earlier V3-V5 experiments; this is not new independent external validation.
Only seven subjects; S02 has GOOD examples only.
Cached V4 pose features reused; raw-video feature extraction was not retrained or independently audited.
GOOD=GB; BAD=LLK/PB only; not all unsafe techniques are represented.
